add_library(dodev_symbols_core STATIC src/SourceSymbols.cpp src/ClangSymbols.cpp)
target_link_libraries(dodev_symbols_core PUBLIC dodev_services)
target_include_directories(dodev_symbols_core PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_compile_features(dodev_symbols_core PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
add_library(dodev_source_symbols_plugin MODULE src/SourceSymbolsPlugin.cpp)
target_include_directories(dodev_source_symbols_plugin PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
set(DODEV_SYMBOLS_BUILD_DIR "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/plugins/source-symbols")
set(DODEV_SYMBOLS_INSTALL_DIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/source-symbols")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${DODEV_SYMBOLS_BUILD_DIR}")
set_target_properties(dodev_source_symbols_plugin PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "dodev_source_symbols_plugin"
 LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${DODEV_SYMBOLS_BUILD_DIR}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${DODEV_SYMBOLS_BUILD_DIR}")
foreach(cfg DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
 set_target_properties(dodev_source_symbols_plugin PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} "${DODEV_SYMBOLS_BUILD_DIR}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} "${DODEV_SYMBOLS_BUILD_DIR}")
endforeach()
configure_file(plugin.json "${DODEV_SYMBOLS_BUILD_DIR}/plugin.json" COPYONLY)
install(TARGETS dodev_source_symbols_plugin LIBRARY DESTINATION "${DODEV_SYMBOLS_INSTALL_DIR}" RUNTIME DESTINATION "${DODEV_SYMBOLS_INSTALL_DIR}")
install(FILES plugin.json DESTINATION "${DODEV_SYMBOLS_INSTALL_DIR}")
add_custom_command(TARGET dodev_source_symbols_plugin POST_BUILD COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E echo "[DoDevEditor][Symbols][build] $<TARGET_FILE:dodev_source_symbols_plugin>")
install(CODE "message(STATUS \"[DoDevEditor][Symbols][install] \${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${DODEV_SYMBOLS_INSTALL_DIR}\")")
